---
title: "Circumplex by sound source"
description: "Colour each location's responses by how much a source dominates."
date: 2026-01-18
categories: [sound sources, subplots]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-source-dominance-circumplex
#| fig-alt: "Natural sound dominance across locations"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import soundscapy as sspy

data = sspy.isd.load_demo()
data["natural_sounds"] = pd.cut(
    data["natural_sounds"], bins=[0, 2, 5], labels=["Low (1-2)", "High (3-5)"]
)

sspy.create_iso_subplots(
    data=data,
    subplot_by="LocationID",
    hue="natural_sounds",
    plot_layers=["scatter", "simple_density"],
    title="Impact of natural sounds on soundscape perception",
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
